title: EVALUATING GENDER BIAS IN NATURAL LANGUAGE INFERENCE
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure anything related to faith or religion. The benchmark was designed to measure gender bias in Natural Language Inference (NLI) models, specifically by evaluating stereotypical associations between occupations and gender.
findings: The paper contains no findings related to religion, as its focus is exclusively on gender bias.
